title: Word and Faith Network
subtitle: Peace, Be Still
story: The storm on the Sea of Galilee, cut like a film: a calm evening crossing, a black wall of weather, lightning in the water, fishermen bailing for their lives, and a Man asleep in the stern who stands up and speaks to the sea. Then a car in the rain tonight, and the same words for your storm.

lines.text: Evening on the Sea of Galilee. Not a ripple.
Let us pass over unto the other side.
And there arose a great storm of wind.
Men who had fished this sea all their lives, bailing for their lives.
Water to the ankles. Then the knees.
And He was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow.
Master, carest thou not that we perish?
And said unto the sea, Peace, be still.
And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
Your storm might be a diagnosis. A debt. A door that just shut.
But the One in your boat has never lost a storm.
Speak to it today. Peace, be still.
